findings.body: This test fabricates `plants_revoked` through a mocked frontend API and exercises only jsdom; the backend tests likewise replace `AppDb` with stubs. There is no required end-to-end test that creates a saved view and pin through the running API with a real database, changes plant grants, verifies the disabled cards in a browser, and confirms runnable cards reopen with the correct origin. Done-when item 8 is therefore proven only by unit/component tests.
findings.title: Not done: Saved views and pins keep their plants through the real user flow

findings.body: The dialog test injects a plain object containing `userMessage`, while the API test mocks `fetch` and the service tests never cross an HTTP route. No browser test against the running API demonstrates that invalid save and pin requests actually return the typed 400 envelope and that both dialogs render its plain-language message. This leaves the user-facing portion of Done-when item 9 unit-only.
